_notes: Ragefire Chasm fixed boss loot (Kyle, 2026-09-06): 4 real WoW Classic bosses (Oggleflint, Taragaman the Hungerer, Jergosh the Invoker, Bazzalan), 3 items each, full stat/slot spread so every archetype has a reason to want each boss dead - no trinkets (reserved as genuinely rare per Kyle's call), no repeated slot+stat combo against Sunken Grotto's table (data/loot/sunken_grotto_boss_loot.json) or within this file. All numbers computed from the real formulas in entities/loot_generator.py at item_level 16, rarity 'rare' (RFC's real Classic level range is 15-17), same as every other fixed boss table - see entities/boss_loot.py for how this file is loaded and wired into combat.

Oggleflint.name: Trogg Warlord's Maul
Oggleflint.flavor_text: Still crusted with cave-stone and worse.

Oggleflint.name: Warband Shoulderguard
Oggleflint.flavor_text: Marked with the trogg warband's crude sigil.

Oggleflint.name: Cave-Warlord's Signet
Oggleflint.flavor_text: Too small for trogg fingers - taken as tribute, not worn.

Taragaman the Hungerer.name: Hungerer's Warmaul
Taragaman the Hungerer.flavor_text: Still radiates the heat of the chasm's deepest fires.

Taragaman the Hungerer.name: Enslaved Cinderspirit Pendant
Taragaman the Hungerer.flavor_text: A fragment of the elemental spirit Taragaman bound to his will.

Jergosh the Invoker.name: Invoker's Grasp
Jergosh the Invoker.flavor_text: Still warm from the last Immolate it channeled.

Jergosh the Invoker.name: Searing Blade Cultist's Cloak
Jergosh the Invoker.flavor_text: Marked with the sigil of a cult that answers to no orc.

Jergosh the Invoker.name: Warlock's Binding Ring
Jergosh the Invoker.flavor_text: The binding runes are still legible, if you dare read them aloud.

Bazzalan.name: Bazzalan's Sinister Edge
Bazzalan.flavor_text: The poison groove never quite runs dry.

Bazzalan.name: Satyr-Stitched Legguards
Bazzalan.flavor_text: Stitched from hides no honest tanner would touch.

Bazzalan.name: Cultist Leader's Chain
Bazzalan.flavor_text: Bazzalan wore this even after he stopped needing to prove anything.
